coder_notes: Registered phase NA (fails S3 at [CODE] level) but coded in full. Title names glioblastoma while inclusion allows newly diagnosed high-grade glioma -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Peptide vaccines are excluded types; poly-ICLC is registered within the vaccine interventions as an 'immunomodulator' and coded as a candidate by analogy with the manual's pembrolizumab + vaccine example, flagged for adjudication. Temozolomide (Stupp) received by every patient = soc_backbone. Neoantigen-count requirement (exclusion criterion 12) is a tumour-sequencing entry requirement for vaccine manufacture, not matched to a candidate. HLA ligandome is germline/HLA and not coded. T-cell response endpoint is linked to the vaccines plus immunomodulator jointly, so target engagement coded unclear.
